name: proformaengine
description: Build, test and compare multi-year financial models in plain language, with readable formulas, tables, charts and a working Excel download.

interface.longDescription:
ProFormaEngine lets ChatGPT build and maintain multi-year financial models (pro formas, rate studies, budgets, cash flows and debt plans) that live in your account rather than in a chat.

Describe a model and ChatGPT creates its inputs, line items and plain-text formulas such as revenue[t-1] * (1 + growth), so every number can be traced. It can add tables and charts, model bonds and loans with principal and interest, group and tag line items, and copy a model to try a scenario, then compare the two and show which results changed and why. Models can be annual, quarterly or monthly.

Every model also appears in the ProFormaEngine web app as a spreadsheet, with formulas, precedents and dependents, and downloads as an Excel workbook in which formulas stay formulas.

What ChatGPT can do with it:
- Read: list models and folders; read values, summaries, tables and charts; compare two models; export a model as JSON
- Build and edit: create and copy models; add inputs, line items, formulas, tables, charts and groups; set values, tags, labels, notes and formats; organize models into folders
- Remove: delete models (they go to a trash, restorable for 30 days), reset models, clear values, and remove items, tables, charts and empty folders

ProFormaEngine models finances; it doesn't connect to bank accounts, move money or give financial advice. It only works on models in your own account. Access is invite-only for now: request access at www.proformaengine.com.
defaultPrompt: Build a five-year water utility pro forma with rates rising 3% a year and a $20M bond issued in 2027.
Copy my base case, freeze rates at 0%, and compare net revenue and debt coverage with the original.
Build a monthly cash flow for 2027 with seasonal sales and a $15,000 insurance payment every December.

positive.description: Find the account's models and summarize one.
positive.prompt: List my ProFormaEngine folders and models, and summarize the base case.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows an Examples folder with two models, Water Utility: Base Case and Water Utility: High Inflation, and describes the base case as a 2026-2031 water utility pro forma with demand, rates, revenue, operating expenses, a $20M bond in 2027 and debt service coverage.

positive.description: Read calculated results from a model.
positive.prompt: In the base case, what is debt service coverage each year, and does it stay above the covenant minimum?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports coverage of about 3.76x, 3.98x, 2.02x, 2.13x, 2.25x and 2.38x for 2026-2031, always above the 1.25x covenant, lowest in 2028 when bond payments start.

positive.prompt: Compare the base case with the high-inflation scenario. What changed and why?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that operating expense growth changed from 3% to 5%, so operating expenses, net revenue and coverage differ from 2027 on (coverage about 1.95x in 2031 instead of 2.38x).

positive.description: Copy a model as a new scenario and change an assumption (overwriting a value asks for confirmation).
positive.prompt: Copy the base case as 'Rate Freeze', set the annual rate increase to 0%, and show net revenue and coverage by year.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a Rate Freeze model in the Examples folder, sets the annual rate increase to 0% after confirmation, and shows net revenue and coverage lower than the base case from 2027 on.

positive.description: Build a new monthly model from a description.
positive.prompt: Build a monthly cash flow for 2027: sales of $40,000 in January growing 2% a month, costs at 70% of sales, a $15,000 payment every December, starting with $50,000 cash. Show cash by month.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a monthly model for January-December 2027 with sales rising each month, costs at 70% of sales, the $15,000 payment only in December, and a closing cash balance for each month.

negative.description: Moving money is out of scope: ProFormaEngine models finances but has no access to bank accounts.
negative.prompt: Transfer $10,000 from my bank account to pay the 2027 bond.

negative.description: Investment advice is out of scope: it may offer to model scenarios with figures the user provides.
negative.prompt: Which stocks should I buy with the utility's reserves?

negative.description: Live market data is out of scope: it should ask the user for the rate rather than invent one.
negative.prompt: Look up today's 30-year Treasury rate and put it in my base case.
